# N30: Small workspaces: a tab or a module’s row waits until it has something in it, and every address still opens

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/notes/30-small-menu.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

small workspaces, rows and tabs that wait (SM1, rule 1). [SMALL-MENU] In the demo the menu is unchanged (it has a metric, so Metrics is a row). On Goals no tab but All is the same list as All, a tab is drawn only with goals in it, and every hidden scope's address still opens: ?scope=team (to All when My team waits) and ?scope=watching. In a workspace with no metric the Metrics row waits, also when you switch to it from one that has a metric without the page reloading (build review of #461: the row once followed you there).

## Where it looks

- 1440 × 900, as rhea, at `/goals?scope=all`
- 1440 × 900, as tunde, at `/goals?scope=all`
- 1440 × 900, as oskar, at `/goals?scope=all`
- 1440 × 900, as hamid, at `/goals?scope=all`
- 1440 × 900, as grace, at `/goals?scope=all`

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day. {…} is a value the script works out as it runs.

## What it reports as wrong

- {who}: the demo's menu has no Metrics row, though it has metrics (its test: `.count() > 0`)
- {who}: Goals has no All tab
- {who}: the {t.name} tab is drawn with nothing in it (its test: `t.n > 0`)
- {who}: the {t.name} tab is drawn though it is the same list as All ({t.n})
- {who}: /goals?scope={scope} does not open
- a workspace with metrics has no Metrics row (its test: `metricsRow() > 0`)
- switched from a workspace with metrics to one with none, the Metrics row followed (its test: `metricsRow() === 0`)
- a workspace with no metric has a Metrics row (its test: `metricsRow() === 0`)
- no metrics: crashed ({String(e.message || e).split('\n')[0]})
